in_hebrew.name: ערביאלה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Lord is my strength and my refuge, my savior and my fortress, my God, the rock in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold and my refuge, my savior; you save me from violence. Therefore I will sing praises to you, O Lord, because you have dealt bountifully with me.

in_greek.name: Arabeila
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Mountain of God
in_greek.long_meaning: Arabeila είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek name Arabē, which means 'mountain of God'. In Greek mythology, Arabe was a nymph who lived in a mountain cave and was known for her hospitality to travelers.

in_latin.name: Arabeila
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Mountain of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Arabeila est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek name Arabē, which means 'mountain of God'. In Greek mythology, Arabe was a nymph who lived in a mountain cave and was known for her hospitality to travelers.
